curations.textual_observation: The passage places Lachish within Sennacherib’s campaign, the historical setting represented by the Assyrian reliefs and investigated at the city gate.
curations.uncertainty: The text and relief are distinct witnesses, and the passage does not identify the excavated gate as the exact gate shown in the palace relief.
curations.why: The passage places Lachish within Sennacherib’s campaign, the historical setting represented by the Assyrian reliefs and investigated at the city gate.

curations.textual_observation: Isaiah names Lachish in its account of Sennacherib’s campaign, while the Lachish reliefs preserve an Assyrian royal depiction of a siege at the city.
curations.uncertainty: The relief is an independent Assyrian representation, not an illustration of Isaiah or proof of every biblical detail; the exact relation between royal imagery and the biblical account remains interpretive.
curations.why: Isaiah names Lachish in its account of Sennacherib’s campaign, while the Lachish reliefs preserve an Assyrian royal depiction of a siege at the city.
